childs.text: Crimson Horde is a brutal barbarian land. The Horde's cavalry wipes everything out of its way and the shamans are eager to learn the secrets of the dark magic.
childs.name: instance25392

childs.name: instance25366

childs.text: The generals were too cautious. The brave leader can seize any stronghold!It's time to seize the magic tower.
childs.name: instance15649

childs.text: What a blinding light!Avatars of the Lord came to punish the heathens!Let's wipe the barbarians out in our belowed land.
childs.name: instance15653

childs.text: Congratulations, my Lord! Magic towers grant powerful magic and sacred might. Special units can be hired here as well.Moreover, magic towers recharge your ultimate power. Click it now to unleash the power of the Lord!
childs.name: instance15657

childs.text: Our generals recommend to attack the Magic Tower first. It will be better to gather 2 or more squads.You can select multiple squads by dragging the selection box over their icons.
childs.name: instance15661

childs.text: Friendly priests have survived the enemy assaultand offer their help in battle.Set the Banner of Consecration in the battlefieldand your troops near the banner will be healed.
childs.name: instance15665

childs.text: It's better to gather 2 or more squads.You can select multiple squads by dragging the selection box over their icons.
childs.name: instance15672

childs.text: Well done! Now we can hire a squad and start our attack.Our generals recommend to attack the Magic Tower first. You will spot some Ogres on your way.Defeat them and take their treasure chests.
childs.name: instance15673

childs.text: My lord, Horde barbarians occupy a well fortified castle in the north. More bad news: our camp can't even supply a squad. But farms can give us additional supply points.Click build site and press farm construction button.
childs.name: instance15680

childs.text: It was a glorious battle my Lord!Now you'd better leave your troops in the town for a while to let them restore the town and to reinforce the squads.After that, kick Undead out of the northern castle.
childs.name: instance15687

childs.text: Hooray! We've re-estabiled the order, my Lord.Now you will constantly gain gold. Use it to hire Guards and Archers.Unfortunately a castle can't support more than 2 squads.But if you seize this town you will be able to hire more squads.
childs.name: instance15691

childs.text: Undead forces are advancing,  my lord! Drag the Guards icon onto the  enemy squad to attack it!
childs.name: instance15695

childs.text: Well trained Guards are ready to protect our lands.Click the button to hire your first squad.
childs.name: instance15699

childs.text: My Lord! The neighbour strongholds were seized by undead!We must defend your manor castle!Click the castle.
childs.name: instance15703

childs.text: You pay with GOLD to purchase troops and buildings. It is also required to support squads.
childs.name: instance15743

childs.text: GOLD is generated by Castles, Towns, Towers andMines.
